instruction.text: Find the image of winter on the diagram to learn more.

feedback.end: After autumn, it’s winter time. The months of December, January and February make up winter.

instruction.text: Find the snow on the ground to learn more about the weather in the winter.

feedback.correct: During these months, it gets dark early and stays quite cold. We also get snowy weather, frost and lots of wet weather during the winter.

instruction.text: Find the snow on the tree to learn more about plants during the winter.

text: In the winter, only evergreen trees stay green and keep their leaves. In the UK, most plants will not grow much during winter.

instruction.text: Which of these things do you think you would see in winter? Drag the images to the correct groups.

hint.text: Select an image to hear a description.

feedback.finish: Great work! It is much more common to see robins during the winter. They are famous for their red breast feathers, which brighten up the grey winter.
